notes:
• Operator: off by default, with an on/off switch at the top of Settings → Operator on the Mac. Its model, to-do and summary settings show once it's on. While off, no app shows the Operator, no summaries are written and new to-dos stay in the list; turning it on or off shows or hides it on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android right away.
• Stellwerk for Mac: Usage tab → "Use the account with the most of its week left". New turns run on the Claude account that has used the least of its weekly limit; Stellwerk switches once another is 5 points lower (asking it first with a one-word Haiku turn, so the number is fresh) and, when limits run out, to the account with the most left.
• Mac: links in replies are blue, like on the iPhone and Android. They had the text colour before.
• Stellwerk for Mac: when the window can't reach the Mac's own host, it says why (busy, not listening, connection broke off) instead of asking about Tailscale. The API server starts again by itself if it stops. The host log (Copy diagnostics) now notes when the window loses and regains its host, and when the host stalls because every thread waits for a tool, with the tools running then.
• A message sent to a new workspace before its folder is there waits in the chat's queue and goes out once it is, instead of failing with "The workspace's folder isn't there (yet)". Creating the folder fetches the default branch first, which can take a while (up to two minutes when GitHub is slow).
